arguments.prompt: Socialist housing estate in winter, December 1982, Dubravka Bratislava. Cosy, slightly ironic chamber piece at 88 BPM in D minor turning to F major: soft analog polysynth pads and a warm monophonic analog synth lead in the style of early 80s Eastern European TV and cartoon scores, celesta and glockenspiel sparkle like snow, pizzicato strings, upright bass, light brushed drums. Warm interiors, frosty windows, quietly funny. Instrumental only, absolutely no vocals, no singing, no humming, no spoken words, no choir. Video game background score for a warm, gentle, humorous point-and-click adventure about a kind repairman who travels through time in Bratislava, Slovakia. Civil and friendly, never epic or dark. Steady tempo and steady texture from start to finish so it can loop: no fade-in, no fade-out, no big finale, no long silence; keep the same energy throughout, ending on the groove. Length about 2 minutes 30 seconds.
